title: Reo's Japanese Streets
description: Bring a little japanese everyday life into your world!
body:
# Reo's Japanese Streets 
![Street screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2ab9f3e6b19247776b246dc704ee841a09ea5b19.jpeg)
## Features
Create the _Paint Brush _for painting your street lines!
Create _asphalt_ and typical _inaka walls_ and _riverbanks_!
Create iconic _Tokyo slopes_! _Tactile pavings_!
**_99% Survival friendly!_**

The Paint Brush can be crafted with 1x Stick, 1x String, 1x Feather.
Right-clicking a block on the ground cycles through the different lines.
Crouching while right clicking will let you rotate the paint.

### External resources:
The screenshots include additional mods such as:
[Yuushya for Fabric](https://modrinth.com/mod/unofficial-yuushya-townscape-for-fabric) and
[Psithurism](https://modrinth.com/mod/psithurism). 
Since the original author of [Japan Props](https://modrinth.com/mod/japan-props) hasn't updated his mod to newer versions, and I wanted to include a guardrail, I included his model. 

If he ever updates his mod, I will remove his model.
